title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
headline: OpenAI initiates embedded independent safety assessments with four external partners
summary: OpenAI has engaged four independent assessors—Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire—to conduct embedded evaluations of its AI models and safety systems. These assessors are granted deep access to internal resources, including model checkpoints, source code, and training data, to test alignment and safeguard effectiveness. The program includes oversight by OpenAI's Safety and Security Committee and aims to establish shared standards for third-party AI assessment.
why_it_matters: This model of deep-access, embedded third-party evaluation provides a potential blueprint for Australian organisations and regulators seeking to implement rigorous, evidence-based assurance for high-risk AI systems.

quotes.text: Embedded assessments give independent experts deep access to a lab’s internal models and systems to assess model alignment and the effectiveness of safeguards over an extended period of time
These collaborations can contribute to stronger shared standards for independent assessment and public transparency across the industry.

classification.significance_reason: Represents a significant shift in industry practice for independent AI safety assurance, establishing new protocols for deep-access third-party auditing.
